title: Record the six-stage rotating address walk
body:
## Summary
- The rotating walk's spectator axes are 1, 8, 15, 22, 29 and 36, and it closes at dimension 43.
- The moves have ranks `{1: 6, 6: 6, 7: 6}` and mass 84, two below the capacity `2 × 43`.
- XORing axes 0 and 36 into the second bank meets the first bank's endpoint. The selected κ is unchanged.
